notes:
Summary: EU-based financial services platform evaluating Redwood Private (VPC) for sensitive customer workflows. Primary ask: exhaustive audit logging + SIEM integration, strict EU residency, BYOK/KMS + HSM validation, and demonstrable log retention and access controls.

Security/Compliance highlights:
- Must export real-time and batched audit logs to customer SIEM (Splunk/Datadog/QRadar). Preferred delivery: HTTPS syslog over TLS or S3 bucket (server-side encrypted) with lifecycle hooks.
- Required log formats: JSON+newline (preferred), CEF optional, must map to SIEM fields. Provided list of required fields on call: timestamp, request_id, trace_id, customer_id, project_id, model_id, model_variant, prompt_hash, response_hash (SHA256), token_input_count, token_output_count, latency_ms, kv_cache_hit_boolean, node_id, shard_id, bytes_in, bytes_out, principal_id, principal_role, source_ip, action_type, status_code, error_code, retention_tag.
- Retention: immutable audit trail for a minimum of 7 years for security/audit logs; access logs (authentication/console/API) selectable 1–3 years depending on retention tier. Legal insists on WORM-ish assurances for audit logs and exportable manifests for audits.
- PII handling: CTO requested "no plaintext PII in traces" — Redwood must offer redaction/tokenization hooks before logs leave VPC or allow customer-side pre-processing lambda.
- SIEM mapping: customer will run staging ingestion test. They need a sample 24h log bundle (production-like) + schema mapping doc (field names/types). Redwood asked to deliver by 2026-03-12.
- KMS/BYOK: must integrate with customer AWS KMS and CloudHSM for envelope encryption of logs at rest and for key wrapping. Key rotation policy must be documented; no ability for Redwood-managed key export. HSM attestation required for production.
- Access controls & audit: fine-grained RBAC for who can view logs, immutable change history for retention/policy changes, and an audit trail of read access (who/when).
- Network/topology: customer requires logs never egress to non-EU regions. VPC peering/PrivateLink preferred. Corporate firewall rules will be provided after NDA.

Quotes and shorthand from calls:
- CTO (M. Reiner): "If we can't prove the logs are complete and unalterable for 7 years, we won't go live."
- Head of Infosec (A. Novak): "Need Splunk ingestion test before procurement. Provide sample fields + compressed bundle."
- AE (J. Morales): "Focus on audit schema + KMS playbook; legal to review residency clauses next week."

Technical asks for POC:
- Deliverables: SIEM export spec (JSON schema + example messages), 24h synthetic log bundle (compressed), KMS integration runbook, VPC diagram with egress controls.
- POC target: 2-week deploy in test VPC, forward logs to customer Splunk instance, validate ingestion and retention alerts.

Risks & concerns:
- Legal needs explicit data residency SLA and contractual clause for EU-only storage.
- Potential need for on-prem appliance or broker if HSM attestation cannot be satisfied with cloud HSM.
- Network/NAT rules might require additional tunnel config; infra budget for VPN/PrivateLink not yet approved.

Next internal owners: Priya to finalize SIEM schema; Infra eng to scope KMS/HSM steps; Legal to draft residency addendum.
